text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feeling a slight discomfort in her legs, 
Sirius Symboli quietly took time to 
recover.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unaware of the true circumstances, rumors 
spread among those around her that she is 
withdrawing from the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she calmly focused on her 
recovery and entered the Satsuki Sho in 
peak condition.
